summary: Manual production/staging QA ledger for sunflower-admin-web MVP operations. Keep secrets, phone numbers, SMS codes, raw screenshots, and real payment/order payloads out of Git.

environment.notes: Replace with HTTPS/domain evidence when the production domain is ready. Do not commit account credentials.

checks.requirement: Dedicated QA admin can login with password, reach the protected workspace, refresh the browser, recover the session through /api/admin/account/me, and logout cleanly.
checks.nextAction: Run with a dedicated non-production-impact admin account and record date, environment, account role label, and sanitized result.

checks.requirement: Allowlisted admin account can request SMS code and complete first activation without committing the phone number or SMS code.
checks.nextAction: Use allowlisted QA phone/account, then record masked phone suffix and sanitized success/failure summary only.

checks.requirement: Password reset and in-session password change work for a dedicated QA account, and the old session/password cannot continue unintentionally.
checks.nextAction: Run only on a dedicated QA account; restore final credentials outside Git.

checks.requirement: Workspace loads protected shell, account header, business overview cards, backend health, and report summary without console/runtime errors.
checks.nextAction: Record sanitized browser/runtime result and API status summary.

checks.requirement: Room list loads, keyword/status filtering works, and a test room can be created or edited with reversible field changes.
checks.nextAction: Use a clearly named QA room or an approved existing room; record before/after summary without raw customer data and restore or explicitly accept the final change.

checks.requirement: Room shelf status can be toggled active/inactive and restored to the original state.
checks.nextAction: Run on QA room or approved room only; record the restored final status.

checks.requirement: Pricing page loads rooms and calendar for an approved room/date range.
checks.nextAction: Record room alias, date range, and sanitized calendar load result.

checks.requirement: Batch price and inventory update succeeds for approved QA dates and can be restored or accepted as intended.
checks.nextAction: Use future QA dates to avoid live customer impact; record sanitized updated counts and restore, accept, or waive the final state explicitly.

checks.requirement: Order list, status filter, keyword filter, check-in date range filter, and detail drawer work against current backend data.
checks.nextAction: Record sanitized order id suffix or QA order alias, filter conditions, and result.

checks.requirement: Check-in, check-out, no-show, reschedule, and direct refund actions are validated with approved QA orders or explicitly waived when no safe data exists.
checks.nextAction: Use only approved QA orders; otherwise record user waiver for unsafe production mutations.

checks.requirement: After-sale approve/reject and failed refund retry controls are validated when matching QA data exists, or explicitly waived if no safe data exists.
checks.nextAction: Run against QA after-sale/refund data or record explicit waiver with reason.

checks.requirement: Unauthorized session, backend error, empty state, and invalid form feedback are understandable and do not trap the operator.
checks.nextAction: Record sanitized examples of redirect/error/empty/form feedback behavior.
